# Wiki Emitter

The Wiki Emitter is responsible for generating Markdown files that encapsulate engineering knowledge in a format conforming to the OKF specification. It processes knowledge entities and their relationships, regenerating necessary pages, including logs and recent changes, based on compile deltas.
